name: barcode-field
title: Barcode field
description: EAN-13, UPC-A and EAN-8 numbers grouped as printed on the pack, with the check digit verified and a missing one added in a tap.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { digits, format, valid }: digits are the digits without spaces, format is ean13, upca or ean8 (null while a number in auto is too short to tell) and valid is true when the number is complete and its GS1 check digit is right. The text is written in groups as it is printed, 4 006381 333931 for an EAN-13, 0 36000 29145 2 for a UPC-A and 7351 3537 for an EAN-8, however it is typed or pasted (spaces, hyphens and letters are dropped, and an extra zero in front of a pasted GTIN-14 is dropped too), and the caret stays after the same digit. format fixes one format, or auto (the default) reads it from the length: 13 digits is an EAN-13, 12 a UPC-A, 8 an EAN-8. While the field is in use, twelve digits that are a right UPC-A are not called finished, since they may be the front of an EAN-13: the line stays neutral (Valid as a UPC-A. Typing an EAN-13? One more digit.), the check mark waits until the field is left and Add check digit offers the one the EAN-13 asks for. A wrong last digit is said at once and says what it should have been; a number one digit short offers the check digit it asks for as a button (Add check digit 1); a number that is still short is only called wrong once the field has been left. The line under the field says which format was read and how far along the number is. trailing takes something of your own at the end of the field, such as a Scan button. name adds a hidden input with the digits, id lands on the input, and required, disabled and placeholder work as on any input. checkDigit, isValidBarcode, groupBarcode and readBarcode are plain functions in barcode-field/gs1, for the server.
